verdict.rationale: EmailOctopus's own marketing pages cover each step of the loop. Campaigns are composed with a drag-and-drop editor, custom HTML or templates. Subscribers are organised and segmented so specific emails can target them. Timed sending is claimed. The audience-picking and send/schedule steps rest on brief marketing lines rather than detailed docs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the campaign send and schedule flow, explicit per-campaign audience selection docs, independent hands-on corroboration of the loop.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can compose an email campaign, pick its audience, and send or schedule it — the arena's table-stakes loop
